subject: Big maple leaning over my garage
body:
Hi there,

After last night's storm the big maple in our backyard in Collingwood is leaning toward the garage and one of the main limbs is cracked. Can someone come look at it this week? It feels like it could come down.

Also, do we need a permit from the town to take it down? It's a big tree, probably 60 cm across.

Thanks,
Dana
705-555-0188

subject: Seasonal tree work for 12 cottages near Thornbury
body:
Hello,

I manage Maple Hill Cottages, a group of 12 rental cottages just outside Thornbury. We're looking for a company to handle fall pruning across the properties and remove two dead ash trees near the parking area before winter.

Do you service the Thornbury and Blue Mountains area, and roughly what would something like this cost? Ideally we'd get it done in October before the season picks up.

Best,
Priya Raman
Property Manager, Maple Hill Cottages
